author: The Associated Press
title: Texas All or Nothing Night Drawing Results and Weather Report
text:
• The winning numbers for the "Texas All or Nothing Night" game on Wednesday evening were: 1, 4, 6, 10, 11, 12, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 23.
• The weather forecast for overnight is cloudy with showers.
• The low temperature is forecast to be 62F.
• Winds are expected from the South at 10 to 20 mph.
• There is an 80% chance of rain.
• The article was updated on April 1, 2026 at 11:14 pm.
